children: Huddlestock Fintech AS (“Huddlestock” or the “Company”) has appointed Christian Engen as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), effective 1 December 2026. He will join the executive management team and take responsibility for the Group’s finance function.

Christian has broad experience across finance, operations, business development and technology. He currently serves as Chief Operating Officer of River Security, where he also leads the finance function. There he has built finance, reporting and management processes across the company’s Norwegian and Swedish entities through a period of strong growth, using automation and AI to keep the organisation lean. He previously headed finance and operations at Unipos, and held commercial and product leadership roles at Hafslund and Fortum. He started his career in accounting and auditing.
Christian holds an MBA from Edinburgh Business School, Heriot-Watt University, and a bachelor’s degree in Accounting and Auditing from BI Norwegian Business School.

“Christian combines a solid finance foundation with operational and commercial experience, and has shown that a company can grow without adding unnecessary cost and complexity. I am genuinely pleased to welcome him to the team, and confident he will make an immediate impact as we build a more integrated Group around a shared direction and make better use of our presence across European markets”
says Ramtin Matin, Interim CEO of Huddlestock.

“Huddlestock has a strong platform and clear commercial opportunities. Alongside building a scalable, technology-enabled finance function, I look forward to working closely with our commercial and technology teams to turn those opportunities into profitable growth.”
The appointment follows the previously announced departure of former CFO Sabine Merky, who remained in her position until 30 September 2026.

Huddlestock is a European Investment-as-a-Service provider enabling financial institutions and digital platforms to launch and scale investment services efficiently and in full regulatory compliance. Through its BaFin-regulated entity, Huddlestock GmbH, the company provides access to a comprehensive liability umbrella and European passporting framework, allowing partners to offer regulated investment services without requiring their own financial license. Combining regulatory infrastructure with a modular, partner-based ecosystem, Huddlestock enables clients to build tailored investment solutions while significantly reducing time-to-market and operational complexity. Huddlestock Group also includes Visigon, a Nordic based consulting company with deep expertise in capital markets and treasury technology.
